name: The Body Corporate
description: Originally produced as a licensed psychological thriller by a mid-tier Vantablack subsidiary, the film was pulled from distribution six weeks after release when its narrative — about a Tier 3 worker discovering their BCI has been harvesting and selling their cognitive labor to a corponation without consent — was found to be based on a real and ongoing practice. The licensed cut was destroyed; the underground version, with twenty additional minutes of documentary appendix, circulates on encrypted mesh.
cultural_impact: The joint suppression order was itself more radicalizing than the film — the spectacle of every corponation agreeing on something for the first time in recorded history told people exactly how real the threat was.
story_hooks: Damilola Achebe-Kovač is alive and in hiding, and the documentary appendix in the underground cut names the specific algorithm still running in millions of BCIs across Meridian 88
A player character running the underground cut on an unshielded BCI feed notices their own device behaving strangely during the documentary segment
Someone is offering significant Quanta for any copy of the film that includes the original licensed opening — before the studio edited it to remove a real corponation name from a background document
